USER_AUTHORIZATION_REFERENCE.CONTEXT: Immediate reply after the project LLM stated that the next V6 step is the separate authorization and preparation of the first Coding-Agent run for the Project Foundation.
USER_AUTHORIZATION_REFERENCE.INTERPRETATION: Authorizes the first V6 Coding-Agent execution for PROJECT_FOUNDATION_ONLY and the repository mutations required for that bootstrap within the boundaries below.
USER_AUTHORIZATION_REFERENCE.LIMITATION: Does not authorize normal product-feature implementation, real Firefox profile testing, add-on publication/signing, production, new paid providers, new secrets, or materially broader data disclosure.

PREIMPLEMENTATION_GATES_PRESERVED: Do not implement product capture/recovery features before the bound platform/recognition qualification required by Technical Foundation §7.1.
Do not implement affected product functionality before the concrete performance measurement method/environment required by §§9.1/9.3 is bound.
The Project Foundation bootstrap may materialize those stop-gates and evidence mechanisms but may not bypass them.
AGENT_REQUIRED_PREFLIGHT: Verify all local package input hashes.
Load Foundation 2 by exact Git blob ff49e56aba09881e9e4a22dc8225949fbc4b54f6 and verify identity.
Recheck repository identity, visibility, branches/commits and working baseline immediately before first mutation.
Verify actual available agent tools/model controls and do not claim unavailable capabilities.
Stop before mutation on any baseline mismatch or material authorization conflict.
STOP_AND_ESCALATE_IF: A material product, high-level architecture, security/trust, sensitive-data, provider, cost, irreversible migration or production decision is required.
The target repository is no longer empty at first-write preflight.
Any exact input hash or Foundation blob identity fails.
The run would need normal product-feature implementation to proceed.
Required repository write capability is unavailable or ambiguous.
POST_RUN_REQUIRED_OUTPUT: PROJECT_FOUNDATION_READY_FOR_REVIEW marker only when genuinely satisfied.
Exact repository end SHA or immutable equivalent.
Summary of foundation capabilities materialized and any justified NOT_APPLICABLE items.
Verification/test/CI evidence with evidence class distinctions.
Open findings by severity and material deviations/decisions.
Canonical Project Foundation Review subject/evidence/result-channel locator prepared for an independent reviewer.
NOTE: This authorization is execution context, not additional Product Truth and not an external review verdict.
